blocks.text: NBA scores today: Spurs, Lakers, Celtics extend winning streaks NEW YORK— James Harden is a three-time NBA scoring champion who averaged more than 30 points in each of those seasons. So when he was managing half that through 11 games this season, there were questions whether he still had it at 37 years old. Harden may have provided his own answer Wednesday with a throwback performance, scoring a season-high 32 points to lead the Cleveland Cavaliers to a 115-107 victory over the New York Knicks. “It’s my 18th year, so my name is James Harden, and I used to score a […]...
